question: The Asafi Imambara built by Asaf-ud-Daula, is located in ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bara Imambara, also known as Asfi Imambara** is an imambara complex in **Lucknow, India.**
 
• It was** built by Asaf-ud-Daula, Nawab of Awadh in 1784.**
 
• This imambara is the** second largest after the Nizamat Imambara.**
 
• **Imambara is a shrine built by Shia Muslims for the purpose of Azadari.**
 
• It was** built to employ people during the 11-year famine,** the nawab planned to build it.
 
• The** famine affected the nobles and the common people.**
 
• **Kifayatullah was the architect** and designer of the monument who came from Delhi and designed it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Asaf-ud-Daula**

 
 
• ​Asaf-ud-Daula was the **Nawab Wazir of Oudh** from 26 January 1775 to 21 September 1797.
 
• He was the** son of Shuja-ud-Dowlah.**
 
• He shifted his **capital from Faizabad to Lucknow in 1755** which contributed to its significant growth.
 
• He** built the 'Daulat Khana' as a residence** for himself to the west of Macchi Bhawan,** the Rumi Darvaza, **and the **Bara Imam Bara.**
